item.title: Cover a turn at the pet club
item.context_text: You and a friend take turns feeding two rabbits at a school pet club. You cannot come at the usual time.
item.objective_text: Explain the short job and find someone who can cover it.
success_conditions: Explain the short job and find someone who can cover it.

children.title: Read the feeding card
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: The rabbits need fresh water and one small bowl of greens each at four. No bread. Mark both tasks on the list when you finish.

questions.prompt: How many bowls of greens do the rabbits get together?
questions.explanation: There are two rabbits and each gets one small bowl.

questions.prompt: Where do you record the jobs?
questions.explanation: The card asks for a mark on the list.

children.title: Hear your classmate’s message
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I can be there at four. I know where the greens are. Is the water in the bottle fresh? I can't stay after half past four.

questions.prompt: What does your classmate know already?
questions.explanation: They say they know where to find the greens.

questions.prompt: What time must your classmate leave?
questions.explanation: They cannot stay after half past four.

children.title: Ask for short cover
children.prompt_text: Your classmate can cover your turn. Thank them and explain the water job.
children.instructions: Ask them to replace the water and tell them the feeding time.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Thanks for coming at four. Please put fresh water in the bottle for the rabbits. Give each rabbit one bowl of greens.

children.title: Send the club a record
children.prompt_text: Another learner checks who is feeding the rabbits today.
children.instructions: Name the replacement, the two tasks and how they will confirm that everything is done. The classmate’s name is Lili.
children.goal: Explain the short job and find someone who can cover it.
children.model_answer: Lili will feed the rabbits at four today. She will give them fresh water and one bowl of greens each. Please do not give the rabbits any bread. Lili will mark both jobs on the list before she leaves.

points.label: Name the replacement and time
any: Lili will feed the rabbits at four

points.label: Confirm the written check
any: mark both jobs on the list
